current.text: Derrick White is projected to start at guard for Boston next to Jayson Tatum and Paul George.
Jaylen Brown has left Boston. Paul George is the clear number two option behind Tatum, so White is the third option.
Experts expect his usage and time on the ball to drop as the third option.
Experts expect his FG% to improve. He should get more catch-and-shoot looks, and Tatum and George share the ball more than Brown did.
Josh thinks lower usage and age will cancel out the better shooting, so he does not expect much overall improvement.
Experts value him around 40 to 50 in category leagues, roughly a round 4 player. They call picks 31 to 35 a little early. They call ESPN's rank of 16 to 17 absurd and see him as a bust at that price.
In auctions, Josh values him in the mid 20s USD. He calls a 14 USD price an unbelievable steal. His average auction cost sits well below his projected value.
Boston has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league, with three in our playoff window. Experts say this mainly affects Paul George and Mitchell Robinson.
Boston plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. That is one game short of the maximum.
Experts see Boston as a better regular-season team than last year. Karalis predicts 48 wins.

durable.text: Experts call him an excellent steals and blocks player. His blocks are far above normal for a guard.
FG% is his clear weak category. He is a low-percentage shooter on real volume.
He is worth much more in category leagues than in points leagues. He finished 39th in categories and 50th in points last season.

note: Experts value White around 40 to 50 in category leagues, or mid 20s USD at auction. Yahoo's 26 USD fits that, but ESPN's 43 USD and the 30 USD he cost in our league last season are too much. Below 25 USD he is good value, especially for a punt FG% build, because his threes, assists, blocks and FT% all help. Early in the season, check whether his FG% climbs back above 42% to 44% as the third option behind Tatum and George, and how much his usage drops.
